name: 06_panel_lower_headroom
mechanism: If the median is closer to p75, the panel has more room below its median. Widen the lower log offset with this asymmetry, more at long horizons.
prediction: Practice pooled skill rises 0.001 to 0.004 through downside moves where the current panel is skewed below its median.
evidence_before_edit: The symmetric upper-panel hypothesis improved practice 0.000422, but does not establish the lower hypothesis. Lower widening gated by recent activity failed.
